eligibility.note: These are HARD filters, not scoring weights. A listing failing any of them is excluded from the watchlist entirely and carries an exclusion reason in the snapshot.
rules: location gate: zoned to an allowlisted elementary OR inside an allowlisted focus zone
eligibility.zoning_source: config/school_zones.geojson -- all 135 Dallas ISD official elementary attendance boundaries, 2026-27 school year. Resolved per listing lat/lng by scrapers/school_zones.py, NOT from the feeder_pattern strings below. elementary_allowlist above must match TARGET_ELEMENTARIES in that module; pipeline/score.py refuses to run if they drift apart.
eligibility.zoning_caveat: Zoning is resolved from the listing's Redfin lat/lng, which is rooftop-accurate but not surveyed. Listings within ~40m of a zone edge are flagged near_zone_edge for manual confirmation on the DISD SchoolFinder before touring.
eligibility.exclusion_reasons: Location failures are reported as wrong_elementary (resolved to a real DISD zone that is not allowlisted -- the actual zone is named) or outside_disd (Richardson ISD or beyond the district). Caching the whole district rather than only the qualifying zones is what makes that distinction possible.

buy_box.preference_notes: No sqft floor -- beds/baths carry the size requirement. The floor had already been walked down from 2,000 to 1,750; it is now removed entirely. Price band tightened to 750K-1M (was 800K-1.1M). Schools are now a hard gate rather than a soft weight: Mockingbird or Lakewood Elementary only, or inside the hand-drawn Lake Highlands zone.

feeder_pattern_warning: The feeder_pattern strings below are neighborhood-level shorthand for orientation ONLY. They are not used by the eligibility gate and several were wrong when checked against official DISD boundaries -- 'Forest Hills' was labeled a Lakewood Elementary feeder but is entirely Hexter. Trust scrapers/school_zones.py, not these strings.

sub_areas.name: Hollywood Heights / Santa Monica
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Wilson HS / Long MS / Lakewood Elementary (E) + Mockingbird Elementary (W)
sub_areas.notes: Best-positioned area in the screen post-gate: its entire footprint sits inside one of the two allowlisted elementary zones, split roughly Lakewood east / Mockingbird west. Conservation district (exterior changes need review). Walking distance to the lake, Lakewood Country Club, Lakewood Shopping Center. 47% YoY $/sqft is a yellow flag (thin sample).

sub_areas.name: Lakewood proper
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Wilson HS / Long MS / Lakewood Elementary
sub_areas.notes: Almost entirely Lakewood Elementary, so it clears the school gate nearly everywhere. Median \$1.6M now sits above the tightened \$1M ceiling, so expect very few price-eligible listings -- only smaller/original-condition homes will surface. Walking distance to White Rock Lake and Lakewood Country Club. Conservation district overlay in some pockets.

sub_areas.name: M Streets / Greenland Hills
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Wilson HS / Long MS / Mockingbird Elementary (northern portion)
sub_areas.notes: Mockingbird Elementary covers only part of this footprint, so per-address zoning matters here more than in Hollywood Heights. Median \$865K sits mid-band under the new ceiling, the best price fit of any Tier S area. Conservation district. Walkable to Greenville Ave. Negative YoY = buyer leverage.

sub_areas.name: Lakewood Heights
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Wilson HS / Long MS / Lakewood Elementary (S) + Mockingbird Elementary (N)
sub_areas.notes: Split between both allowlisted zones, covering most of its footprint. Median \$1.2M is above the new \$1M ceiling, so only the smaller/less-updated end of its ~900 1930s-original homes will be price-eligible.

sub_areas.name: Lakewood Hills
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Wilson HS / Long MS / Lakewood Elementary (southern portion)
sub_areas.notes: North of Mockingbird Ln, south of NW Hwy, east of Abrams. The Lakewood Elementary zone stops partway up, so the northern strip fails the school gate -- verify per address. Median \$1.4M is well over the ceiling; only bottom-of-range listings qualify.

sub_areas.name: Hillside
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Wilson HS / Long MS / Lakewood Elementary
sub_areas.notes: West of White Rock Lake, mostly mid-century ranches built 1951 to early 1960s. Mature trees, serene streetscape. Lakewood Elementary covers nearly all of it. Median ~\$1.3M is over the ceiling, so original-condition ranches are the realistic entry.

sub_areas.name: Wilshire Heights
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Wilson HS / Long MS / Mockingbird Elementary
sub_areas.notes: Mostly Mockingbird Elementary. Median \$1.5M is far above the \$1M ceiling, so expect almost nothing price-eligible; kept for the Mockingbird-side comp set. 97% YoY $/sqft pop is thin-sample noise -- verify against same-block comps.

sub_areas.name: Caruth Terrace
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Wilson HS / Long MS / Mockingbird Elementary (most of footprint)
sub_areas.notes: Small enclave east of Greenville Ave, between Mockingbird Ln (N) and Belmont/Vanderbilt (S). Mostly Mockingbird-zoned, but the two active listings as of the 2026-05-03 snapshot both fell outside the zone -- this is an area where per-address checking earns its keep. Median \$654K sits just under the new floor, so entry-level stock is now too cheap to qualify; the \$750K-1M renovated mid-century band is the target. 66 DOM = negotiation room.

sub_areas.name: Vickery Place
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Wilson HS / Long MS / Mockingbird Elementary (N) + Geneva Heights / Lipscomb (S)
sub_areas.notes: Urban-walkable, M Streets-adjacent. Roughly the northern 60% is Mockingbird-zoned; the southern remainder splits to Geneva Heights and Lipscomb and fails the gate. Median \$1.21M is above the ceiling. +30% YoY is real momentum.

sub_areas.name: Junius Heights / Peak's Suburban / Munger Place
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Wilson HS / Long MS / Lakewood Elementary (about 40% of footprint)
sub_areas.tier_override_reason: Lakewood Elementary feeder over roughly 40% of the footprint, now resolved per address rather than assumed
sub_areas.notes: Historic conservation districts south of Garland Rd / Reiger Ave: Junius Heights, Munger Place, Peak's Suburban. Grid-tested at 41x41 points against the official 2026-27 boundaries: 40% Lakewood Elementary, with the remainder splitting to Mount Auburn (39%), Lipscomb (15%), Roberts (3%) and Geneva Heights (2.5%). The original note said zoning 'splits per street -- confirm via DISD school locator before bidding'; that was correct, and the gate now does exactly that confirmation per listing, so the uncertainty no longer has to be priced in by hand. Original Craftsman / Prairie / Tudor stock from the 1900s-1920s, often renovated. Walk to Lakewood Shopping Center and Tenison Park. Median sits below the \$750K floor, so only the renovated upper end qualifies. lakewood_orbit 0.55 and school_quality_score 6 are kept as deliberately conservative edge-of-orbit values; note the score's school component now comes from the resolved zone, not this field.

sub_areas.name: L Streets (drawn Lake Highlands zone)
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Lake Highlands HS / Lake Highlands JH / Lake Highlands Elementary
sub_areas.notes: Hand-drawn zone, traced from the outline drawn 2026-08-02. Bounded by Audelia Rd (W), Plano Rd (E), East Northwest Hwy (S), and a line tracking just south of I-635/LBJ (N). Qualifies on geography alone, independent of school zoning -- RISD means the DISD elementary gate can never pass here. Edge coordinates come from OpenStreetMap centerlines for those four roads rather than eyeballed pixels: Audelia -96.7179, Plano Rd -96.7004, NW Hwy 32.8640. At \$750K-1M you are 1.3-1.7x the area median, so the resale pool is thinner than in the Lakewood-side areas. Listed before Lake Park Estates and Lake Highlands Estates so that listings inside the drawn zone are labeled with it rather than with the neighborhoods it overlaps.

sub_areas.name: Lake Park Estates
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Bryan Adams HS / Hill MS / Hexter Elementary
sub_areas.notes: Fails the school gate everywhere (Hexter), but its northwest corner falls inside the hand-drawn Lake Highlands zone, so listings there qualify on geography instead. Kept for that overlap only. Mid-century modern, large lots up to 0.5ac. Includes the newer subdivisions Redfin loosely tags as Forest Hills (Wyrick Estates, Eastwood Estates).

sub_areas.name: Lake Highlands Estates
sub_areas.feeder_pattern: Lake Highlands HS / Lake Highlands JH / Lake Highlands Elementary
sub_areas.notes: RISD, so the DISD elementary gate cannot pass here. Sits mostly WEST of Audelia Rd and therefore outside the hand-drawn zone; only its eastern edge (Audelia to about -96.715) qualifies. Premium LH pocket, top-of-band pricing. Feeder pattern is unverified -- only DISD boundaries are cached, and the gate does not depend on it here.

watch_areas.name: Mockingbird Meadows
watch_areas.feeder_pattern: Wilson HS / Long MS / Mockingbird Elementary (western portion)
watch_areas.notes: Promoted in relevance by the school gate: about half its footprint is Mockingbird-zoned, which was not reflected in the old config. 147 DOM = very slow, either a stale market or a hidden opportunity. Median \$662K sits just under the new floor.

removed_2026_08_02.note: Dropped when schools became a hard gate. Every area in the pre-change config was grid-tested at 41x41 points against the official DISD boundaries and the drawn Lake Highlands zone; the six below had ZERO qualifying area anywhere in their bounds. Restore any of them by re-adding the entry from git history.
removed_2026_08_02.retained_on_reconcile: junius_heights was added to main after this work began and was verified before pruning: 40% of its footprint is Lakewood Elementary, so it is kept. Its original feeder_pattern label was accurate, unlike forest_hills.

zero_qualifying_area.forest_hills: Entirely Hexter Elementary / Hill MS / Bryan Adams HS, verified at four corners and all three live listings. The old config claimed Lakewood Elementary and ranked it Tier S with lakewood_orbit 1.0; that was wrong. The Lakewood zone's east edge is -96.7197 and Forest Hills starts at -96.717, so it lies entirely outside.
zero_qualifying_area.old_lake_highlands: Hexter-zoned and entirely west of Audelia Rd, so outside the drawn zone.
zero_qualifying_area.town_creek: RISD and outside the drawn zone (north and west of it).
zero_qualifying_area.moss_farm: RISD and north of the drawn zone.
zero_qualifying_area.merriman_park_estates: RISD and well west of the drawn zone.
zero_qualifying_area.lochwood: Watch area. Hexter-zoned, south and east of the drawn zone.

had_partial_qualifying_area_but_dropped_.casa_linda: About 10% of its footprint is Lakewood Elementary. Dropped by preference on 2026-08-02.
had_partial_qualifying_area_but_dropped_.little_forest_hills: About 11% of its footprint is Lakewood Elementary. Dropped by preference on 2026-08-02.

geometry_note: Most sub-areas are still rectangles, which is a poor model of a neighborhood -- they are used only to drive scraping and to label listings, never to decide eligibility. Eligibility uses real polygons: the DISD attendance boundaries in config/school_zones.geojson and the traced outline on l_streets. Refine the remaining rectangles with DCAD GIS shapefiles when precision matters.
